metadata.standard: WCAG 2.2 Level A & AA (Full AA Conformance - 55 Unique Success Criteria)
metadata.section508Baseline: Revised Section 508 (E205.4 -> WCAG 2.0 A & AA + Trusted Tester v5)

checklist.title: Non-text Content (Automated Presence)
checklist.webCheck: Run axe/Accessibility Insights to flag missing alt attributes on , , and .
checklist.pdfCheck: Run Adobe Checker: verify 'Figures Alternate Text' passes (semantic quality verified in Pass 2).
hints: Automated tools only detect missing attributes, not empty or inaccurate alt text.

checklist.title: Info and Relationships (Automated Syntax)
checklist.webCheck: Run axe/Accessibility Insights to catch orphaned form labels, duplicate IDs, and broken ARIA parent/child roles.
checklist.pdfCheck: Run Adobe Checker: verify 'Tagged PDF', 'Tagged Content', and 'Tables > Regularity' pass.
hints: WCAG 4.1.1 Parsing is obsolete in 2.2, but duplicate IDs still fail here under 1.3.1 / 4.1.2.

checklist.title: Resize Text (Zoom Lock Pre-check)
checklist.webCheck: Verify <meta name='viewport'> does not block zooming (no user-scalable=no or maximum-scale < 2).
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A (PDF viewers natively support zoom; visual check in Pass 3).

checklist.title: Images of Text (OCR Pre-check)
checklist.webCheck: Check automated flags for rasterized text heuristics.
checklist.pdfCheck: Run Adobe Checker: verify 'Document > Image-only PDF' passes (scanned PDFs have OCR applied).

checklist.title: Bypass Blocks (Landmarks Pre-check)
checklist.webCheck: Verify automated scan detects <main> landmark and valid skip-link target IDs.
checklist.pdfCheck: Run Adobe Checker: verify 'Document > Bookmarks' passes on documents over 20 pages.

checklist.title: Page Titled (Presence Pre-check)
checklist.webCheck: Verify <title> element exists and is non-empty.
checklist.pdfCheck: Run Adobe Checker: verify 'Document > Title' passes and Initial View displays Document Title.

checklist.title: Language of Page
checklist.webCheck: Verify <html> element has a valid lang attribute (e.g., lang='en').
checklist.pdfCheck: Run Adobe Checker: verify 'Document > Primary Language' passes (Document Properties > Advanced).

checklist.title: Name, Role, Value (Syntax Pre-check)
checklist.webCheck: Verify valid ARIA roles/attributes and that buttons, links, and inputs have non-empty accessible names.
checklist.pdfCheck: Run Adobe Checker: verify 'Accessibility Permission Flag', 'Tagged Form Fields', and 'Field Descriptions' pass.

checklist.title: Non-text Content (Quality & Decorative)
checklist.webCheck: In ANDI Graphics/Images: verify informative images/SVGs have concise, accurate alt text; decorative images use alt='' or aria-hidden='true'; complex charts have text alternatives.
checklist.pdfCheck: In Tags pane: verify <Figure> tags have meaningful Alt Text, decorative graphics are marked as Artifacts, and drop caps use ActualText.
hints: Logos/images of text must include the exact visible text in their alt attribute.

checklist.title: Info and Relationships (Headings, Lists, Tables, Fieldsets)
checklist.webCheck: In ANDI Structures & Tables: verify headings (<h1>-<h6>) match visual hierarchy without skipped levels; lists use <ul>/<ol>/<dl>; data tables use <th scope='col|row'>; radio/checkbox groups use <fieldset>/<legend>.
checklist.pdfCheck: Verify <H1>-<H6> hierarchy; verify <L>/<LI>/<Lbl>/<LBody> list nesting; verify <TH> has Scope set to Row/Column in Tag Properties.
hints: Use only one <h1> per page for main page purpose; do not use heading tags purely for font sizing.

checklist.title: Meaningful Sequence
checklist.webCheck: In ANDI Structures: toggle Reading Order / linearize page to verify DOM sequence matches logical visual reading order.
checklist.pdfCheck: Compare Tags pane order and Reading Order panel against visual layout top-to-bottom, left-to-right.
hints: Watch out for CSS Flexbox/Grid 'order' or absolute positioning that scrambles DOM reading order.

checklist.title: Sensory Characteristics
checklist.webCheck: Review instructional text to ensure cues do not rely solely on shape, size, visual location, orientation, or sound (e.g., 'click the round green button on the right').
checklist.pdfCheck: Ensure document instructions reference explicit section headings or labels rather than visual position alone.

checklist.title: Use of Color
checklist.webCheck: Verify color is not the sole indicator of meaning: inline links must have underlines (or >=3:1 contrast with surrounding text + non-color hover/focus cue); error/success states and chart series need icons, text, or patterns.
checklist.pdfCheck: Verify inline links, form error states, and chart legends use underlines, labels, or patterns in addition to color.

checklist.title: Contrast (Minimum)
checklist.webCheck: In ANDI Color Contrast: verify normal text >= 4.5:1 and large text (>=18pt or >=14pt bold) >= 3:1. Use CCA to sample text over gradients/images and custom ::selection highlight colors.
checklist.pdfCheck: Use Colour Contrast Analyser (CCA) to test body text (>=4.5:1), large headings (>=3:1), and text inside embedded graphics.
hints: ANDI flags text over background images/gradients for manual sampling with an eyedropper tool.

checklist.title: Images of Text (Visual Verification)
checklist.webCheck: In ANDI Graphics/Images: verify no images of text are used where real CSS-styled text could achieve the same effect (brand logos exempt).
checklist.pdfCheck: Verify no flattened screenshots of text blocks or tables exist inside the PDF.

checklist.title: Non-text Contrast
checklist.webCheck: Verify UI component boundaries (input borders, buttons, checkboxes), focus rings, and meaningful chart graphics have >= 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors.
checklist.pdfCheck: Use Colour Contrast Analyser (CCA) on form field borders, chart bars/lines, and meaningful icons.
hints: Inactive/disabled controls and pure decoration are exempt.

checklist.title: Page Titled (Descriptiveness)
checklist.webCheck: In ANDI Structures: confirm <title> is unique and clearly describes the specific page topic or purpose.
checklist.pdfCheck: Verify Document Properties > Title is descriptive (not a raw filename like 'doc_final_v2.pdf').

checklist.title: Link Purpose (In Context)
checklist.webCheck: In ANDI Links/Buttons: inspect ANDI Output for every link; ambiguous text ('Read more', 'Click here') must have programmatic context (aria-label or enclosing sentence/heading).
checklist.pdfCheck: Verify <Link> tags contain descriptive text or meaningful Alt Text on the <Link> tag.
hints: Avoid relying on title attribute tooltips for accessible link descriptions.

checklist.title: Headings and Labels
checklist.webCheck: In ANDI Structures & Focusable Elements: confirm headings and form labels clearly describe their topic or purpose.
checklist.pdfCheck: Verify heading tags (<H1>-<H6>) and form field tooltips are clear and descriptive.

checklist.title: Label in Name
checklist.webCheck: In ANDI Focusable Elements: verify ANDI Output (accessible name) contains the exact visible text string shown on buttons, links, and inputs.
checklist.pdfCheck: Verify form field Tooltip includes the exact visible field label text.
hints: Critical for voice-control users (e.g., Dragon NaturallySpeaking) who speak visible button labels.

checklist.title: Labels or Instructions
checklist.webCheck: In ANDI Focusable Elements: verify every input has a persistent visible label and format/required instructions associated via aria-describedby.
checklist.pdfCheck: Verify visible labels and format instructions (e.g., MM/DD/YYYY) appear outside placeholder text.
hints: Placeholders alone disappear on typing and fail 3.3.2.

checklist.title: Name, Role, Value (Custom Controls & iframes)
checklist.webCheck: In ANDI Focusable Elements & iframes: verify custom controls expose accurate roles/names and every visible <iframe> has a descriptive title attribute.
checklist.pdfCheck: Verify interactive form fields use accurate field types (checkbox, radio, text) and descriptive tooltips.
hints: Use native <button> and <a href='...'> instead of <div onclick>.

checklist.title: Orientation
checklist.webCheck: Rotate viewport between portrait and landscape in DevTools; confirm content does not lock or break unless essential.
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A (Fixed document aspect ratio).

checklist.title: Identify Input Purpose
checklist.webCheck: Inspect personal info inputs (name, email, tel, address) for valid HTML autocomplete attributes.
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A (No HTML autocomplete attribute in PDF).

checklist.title: Resize Text (200% Zoom)
checklist.webCheck: Set viewport to 1366x768 and zoom browser to 200% (Effective CSS viewport: 683x384); verify no text clips, overlaps, or truncates.
checklist.pdfCheck: Zoom to 200% in Acrobat; check text clarity and ensure no content cuts off.

checklist.title: Reflow (400% Zoom)
checklist.webCheck: Set viewport to 1280x1024 and zoom browser to 400% (Effective CSS viewport: 320x256); verify single-column reflow with no horizontal scrolling (2D tables/maps exempt).
checklist.pdfCheck: Test Acrobat Reflow Mode (Ctrl/Cmd+4 or View > Zoom > Reflow) for clean single-column wrapping.

checklist.title: Text Spacing
checklist.webCheck: Apply WCAG Text Spacing bookmarklet (line height 1.5x, paragraph 2x, letter 0.12x, word 0.16x); verify no text clips or overlaps.
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A (Fixed typography).
hints: Also spot-check Windows High Contrast / forced-colors mode while testing visual overrides.

checklist.title: Content on Hover or Focus
checklist.webCheck: Trigger tooltips/hover menus; verify they are dismissible (Esc), hoverable (pointer can move onto popup), and persistent until dismissed.
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A.

checklist.title: Keyboard
checklist.webCheck: Operate all interactive controls (menus, tabs, sliders, custom dropdowns, media players) using only Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, and Arrow keys.
checklist.pdfCheck: Tab through all interactive form fields and links in Acrobat using keyboard alone.

checklist.title: No Keyboard Trap
checklist.webCheck: Tab into and out of all widgets, modals, datepickers, and iframes; confirm focus never gets stuck.
checklist.pdfCheck: Tab from first page to last without focus trapping.

checklist.title: Character Key Shortcuts
checklist.webCheck: If single-letter/character shortcuts exist, verify they can be turned off, remapped, or only fire when the component has focus.
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A.

checklist.title: Bypass Blocks (Skip Link)
checklist.webCheck: Press Tab on page load; verify a visible 'Skip to main content' link appears and moves focus directly to <main>.
checklist.pdfCheck: Verify Bookmarks panel works to jump directly to major sections.

checklist.title: Focus Order
checklist.webCheck: Tab through the page and modals; confirm focus order follows logical visual sequence and returns to trigger when modals close.
checklist.pdfCheck: Verify Page Properties > Tab Order is set to 'Use Document Structure'.
hints: Avoid tabindex > 0, avoid autofocus on load, and remove hidden/off-screen elements from tab order.

checklist.title: Multiple Ways
checklist.webCheck: Confirm at least two ways exist to find pages on the site (e.g., navigation menu + search, sitemap, or breadcrumbs).
checklist.pdfCheck: Long PDFs include both a linked Table of Contents and Bookmarks.

checklist.title: Focus Visible
checklist.webCheck: Confirm every focusable control displays a clear, visible focus indicator when tabbed to.
checklist.pdfCheck: Verify focus rectangle appears around form fields and links when tabbing.
hints: Never use outline: none without providing a high-contrast custom :focus-visible style.

checklist.title: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
checklist.webCheck: Tab down and up the page; verify sticky headers, footers, or cookie banners never completely hide the focused element.
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A.
hints: Use CSS scroll-padding-top to offset sticky headers.

checklist.title: Pointer Gestures
checklist.webCheck: Verify multipoint (pinch-zoom) or path-based (swipe carousel, slider) gestures have single-click/tap button alternatives.
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A.

checklist.title: Pointer Cancellation
checklist.webCheck: Click and hold mouse down on buttons/links, then drag pointer away before releasing; confirm action does not fire prematurely on mousedown.
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A.

checklist.title: Motion Actuation
checklist.webCheck: If device shake/tilt triggers an action, confirm a standard UI button exists and motion detection can be disabled.
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A.

checklist.title: Dragging Movements
checklist.webCheck: Verify drag-and-drop lists, Kanban boards, or range sliders provide a single-pointer click alternative (e.g., Move Up/Down buttons).
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A.

checklist.title: Target Size (Minimum)
checklist.webCheck: Measure interactive targets (icon buttons, pagination, close X buttons); verify at least 24x24 CSS px or sufficient spacing from neighbors.
checklist.pdfCheck: Verify checkboxes, radio buttons, and links are adequately sized and spaced.
hints: Inline links within paragraphs of text are exempt.

checklist.title: On Focus
checklist.webCheck: Tab onto every input, select dropdown, and link; confirm receiving focus alone does not submit forms or trigger unexpected page changes.
checklist.pdfCheck: Focusing a form field does not auto-trigger page jumps or scripts.

checklist.title: On Input
checklist.webCheck: Change radio buttons, checkboxes, and  dropdowns; confirm changing a value does not auto-submit or redirect without prior warning.
checklist.pdfCheck: Selecting a radio button or dropdown option does not auto-submit without prior warning.

checklist.title: Consistent Navigation
checklist.webCheck: Compare across 2+ pages; confirm global navigation links appear in the exact same relative order.
checklist.pdfCheck: Recurring headers/navigation links appear consistently across pages.

checklist.title: Consistent Identification
checklist.webCheck: Compare across pages; confirm icons/components with identical functions (Search, Print, Close) use consistent labels and alt text.
checklist.pdfCheck: Recurring icons/links use identical labels across the document.

checklist.title: Consistent Help
checklist.webCheck: Compare across pages; if help mechanisms (Chat, Contact Us, FAQ, Phone) exist, verify they appear in the same relative order.
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A (Single document).

checklist.title: Redundant Entry
checklist.webCheck: In multi-step forms/checkouts, verify info entered in Step 1 (e.g., shipping address) auto-populates or is selectable in Step 2.
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A.

checklist.title: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
checklist.webCheck: On login/2FA screens, verify paste is allowed (onpaste not blocked), password managers work, and no cognitive puzzles/CAPTCHAs block login.
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A.

checklist.title: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
checklist.webCheck: Verify audio-only content (podcasts) has a full text transcript; video-only animations have a text transcript or audio track.
checklist.pdfCheck: Embedded audio/video clips include text transcripts.

checklist.title: Captions (Prerecorded)
checklist.webCheck: Play prerecorded videos with audio; confirm synchronized, accurate captions exist (including speaker IDs and sound effects).
checklist.pdfCheck: Embedded video includes synchronized captions.

checklist.title: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
checklist.webCheck: Verify prerecorded video provides either an audio description track OR a full descriptive text transcript.
checklist.pdfCheck: Embedded video has audio description or text transcript.

checklist.title: Captions (Live)
checklist.webCheck: If live streaming audio/video exists, verify real-time synchronized captions are provided.
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A.

checklist.title: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
checklist.webCheck: Confirm prerecorded video has a dedicated audio description track narrating important visual-only actions/text.
checklist.pdfCheck: Embedded video includes an audio description track.

checklist.title: Audio Control
checklist.webCheck: If any audio auto-plays for >3 seconds, verify a control exists to pause/stop or adjust volume independently of system volume.
checklist.pdfCheck: Embedded audio does not auto-play without pause/volume control.

checklist.title: Timing Adjustable
checklist.webCheck: If session timeouts or timed assessments exist, verify users can turn off, adjust, or extend the time limit (at least 10x with 20s warning).
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A (Unless timed JavaScript exists).

checklist.title: Pause, Stop, Hide
checklist.webCheck: Verify auto-playing carousels, sliders, background videos, or auto-updating tickers lasting >5 seconds have a Pause/Stop control.
checklist.pdfCheck: Animated GIFs/multimedia in PDFs have pause/stop controls.
hints: Also check prefers-reduced-motion media query support as a best practice.

checklist.title: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
checklist.webCheck: Verify no video, GIF, or UI animation flashes more than 3 times in any 1-second period.
checklist.pdfCheck: No flashing annotations or embedded media >3 Hz.

checklist.title: Language of Parts
checklist.webCheck: Listen with VoiceOver/NVDA to foreign-language phrases/quotes; verify lang attribute is set so screen reader switches pronunciation cleanly.
checklist.pdfCheck:
Verify Tag Properties > Language is set on or

for foreign-language passages.

checklist.title: Error Identification
checklist.webCheck: Submit forms with missing/invalid fields; verify errors are described in text (not color alone) and announced by VoiceOver/NVDA via aria-invalid and aria-describedby.
checklist.pdfCheck: Form validation alerts describe errors clearly in text.
hints: Best practice: display an error summary list at the top of the form with anchor links to invalid fields.

checklist.title: Error Suggestion
checklist.webCheck: Trigger format/validation errors (e.g., bad email or date); verify error message suggests how to fix it and announces to screen readers.
checklist.pdfCheck: Form validation messages explain expected format.

checklist.title: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
checklist.webCheck: On legal, financial, or data-deletion submissions, verify user can reverse submission, check/correct errors, or confirm before finalizing.
checklist.pdfCheck: Submittable forms allow review/confirmation before final submission.

checklist.title: Name, Role, Value (Dynamic States & Screen Reader)
checklist.webCheck: Operate custom widgets (accordions, tabs, comboboxes, modals, toggles) with VoiceOver/NVDA; verify name, role, and dynamic states (expanded, selected, checked) announce accurately.
checklist.pdfCheck: Read PDF with VoiceOver/NVDA: verify all tags, alt text, table headers, and form states read in logical order.

checklist.title: Status Messages
checklist.webCheck: Trigger toast notifications, search result counts, or loading spinners; verify VoiceOver/NVDA announces them via role='status' or aria-live without moving focus.
checklist.pdfCheck: N/A.
